record.one_liner: Linear is a project management and issue tracking tool for software teams, with a GraphQL API, a TypeScript SDK and an official hosted MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Personal API keys for scripts; OAuth2 (authorization code, PKCE supported) for apps built for other users. critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: API and webhook access is listed as Included on every plan including Free; personal API keys are created in Linear settings. critic: confirmed.
record.api_notes: Single GraphQL endpoint at api.linear.app/graphql with introspection; TypeScript SDK wraps it. Breadth not fully audited.

evidence.quote: The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
For personal scripts API keys are the easiest way to access the API.
It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
so the server is centrally hosted and managed.
Read-write access is provided through https://mcp.linear.app/mcp by default.
